The '''Jodaka system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the [[Great Rim Route]] within the [[Corsair Outback]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The system acquired it's name from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jodaka]] which was situated within it.

==Behind the scenes==
The Jodaka system's first and only appearance was in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' on page 136.<ref name="TEA" />
